requirementCueLines: The Biology major is currently a “minimum requirements” program with no set limit on the number of students admitted, so meeting the minimum entry requirements guarantees admission.

Minimum grades. To be considered for admission, complete the courses below with a minimum grade of 2.0 or higher in each Intro Biology course and a 2.0 or higher combined average for the General Chemistry courses. The grades must be recorded on your unofficial or official transcript(s) .
Must cover content equivalent to UW Bothell’s BBIO 180, 200, 220 series .
Must cover content equivalent to UW Bothell’s BCHEM 143+144, 153+154, 163+164 series .

A personal statement is not required for entry into the Biology major, but you do have the option to submit an optional statement reflecting on your reasons for joining the major, projects and courses you want to engage in, and long-term goals after graduation.
